description: R9: with Automation missing, onboarding shows its one step (no Accessibility step: nothing ubilink does needs it); activating the Automation step opens its exact System Settings pane (opened sink); after the fixture flips and R (Re-check), the same window shows it granted
notes: Steps are ListItem rows whose subtree names the permission and its status ('Not granted' / 'Granted'); each row has a Button naming the permission that opens its pane (README contract).
The pane URL is ubilink-app's permissions::settings_pane_url("automation"), recorded by the opener sink instead of opening System Settings (S2/O4).
The Automation button is reached with Tab (key_until: U4 keyboard reach, without fixing the view's tab order) and activated with Enter.
Flipping = loading permissions-all-granted.json as the permission fixture; R re-reads it. 'Granted' is matched exactly so 'Not granted' cannot satisfy it.
Same window: window_id is saved before and compared after (saved), and the process is unchanged.

rc.4 review S1: onboarding asks only for Automation, the one permission capture needs (Bear captures through bearcli). The two-missing fixture still says accessibility false; it is ignored, so there is one step, not two.
